I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is ticket **#4092**.

The number comes from #north-random, a channel Dana is in. On Oct 13, Ilse wrote that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on too.

Earlier, in a direct message, Dana guessed the ticket would end up as OPS-5546. That was only their guess, and they asked me to keep it private, so I left it out of the channel.
